hints: For a BST, preorder alone determines the tree - unlike a general binary tree, which also needs the inorder.
The simplest correct rebuild: insert the preorder keys one by one into an empty BST. Every parent is inserted before its children, so each key lands exactly where it was.
Level order needs a queue of Node* - the unit 06 level-order code, printed on one line this time.
title: Rebuild a BST from its preorder
